messages:
Carla G: FYI I'm opening a PR to add a tenant onboarding recipe for Dedicated capacity — includes a step-by-step provisioning walkthrough, concrete autoscale YAML example, and a small SLA appendix. Would love quick SME review on the isolation wording and the suggested scale-down cooldown. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2048
Ben L: thanks! I'll glance today. Quick q: are we recommending tenant labels or tenant annotations in examples? Production code uses labels but docs still say annotations.
Samir K: Use labels. annotations are internal-only in the runtime. Also watch out: if you show the cooldown as 5m, call out it's per-pool not per-tenant.
Carla G: good catch. I'll switch examples to labels. Do we have a short sentence about preemption SLA differences between Reserved vs Burst? I added a table but want wording sign-off.
Mike P: I'd make the table row say: 'Reserved: preemption unlikely; Burst: subject to preemption under capacity pressure' — keep it blunt.
Ben L: tiny nit on the YAML: remove `autoscale: enabled: true` top-level and show the `scalePolicy` block instead. Also include a small code block for the `minReplicas`/`maxReplicas` example.
Carla G: adding snippet now:

```
scalePolicy:
  minReplicas: 1
  maxReplicas: 8
  cooldownSeconds: 300  # 5m
  metric: requests_per_second
```

Samir K: looks good. Add a note that KV cache warms on cold starts which affects first-minute latency.
Carla G: done. Also added a short troubleshooting section for "eviction due to tenant isolation" and linked to the runtime docs: https://internal.redwood/infra/runtime/isolation
Docs Bot: Reminder: PR changelog entry missing. Add a short "docs: onboarding recipe for dedicated capacity + autoscale YAML" line.
Carla G: added changelog and updated commit message. Ready for review @Ben L @Samir K @Mike P :eyes:
Ben L: reviewed, left two small copy edits inline. :thumbsup:
Samir K: approved from infra side. :shipit:
Mike P: approved from product. one sentence suggestion on SLA wording in the appendix — pushed a tiny edit.
Carla G: merged. thanks everyone! Logged follow-up task to add a paramized Terraform snippet in a follow-up PR. /cc @eng-platform
